title: Chapter 329
text:
They turned around and saw that Han Xiao was the only one left in the lounge. He was sitting on the sofa and playing with his communicator. He raised his head and glanced at them. "You guys are back. It's just you guys. (UU novel is the fastest to update). For more information, please visit:

。”

Li Ge was confused. "What do you mean?"

"Everyone else has registered as mercenaries and joined my mercenary group. What about you?"

Li Ge was stunned.

Could it be that the others had already obtained the qualifications to be mercenaries? Then wouldn't all their efforts be in vain?!

What was a mercenary group?

A bad premonition arose spontaneously.

"We're already qualified to be mercenaries," Li Ge said honestly.

Han Xiao raised an eyebrow and gave them a quest — Join the Black Star Mercenary. Li Ge and the others had nowhere else to go, so they accepted the quest immediately. They then went back to the Mercenary Hall and joined the mercenary group.

Following that, they triggered the mission that the other players had already accepted. When they saw the faction introduction and the mission requirements, they widened their eyes in annoyance.

Li Ge's expression darkened. This was supposed to be their privilege, but because they had acted on their own accord, they had been left behind by the other players. Thinking about how his teammates had been so smug earlier, he felt humiliated. Not only had they wasted their efforts, but they had also fallen behind in the mission progress.

After asking the other players, Li Ge realized that while the other players were rewarded with an extra 300 contribution points for being the first batch of players to join, he was not.

It was too late for regrets. He might as well have stayed obediently at the start. What was the use of running around randomly? Could it be that they understood the Galaxy better than Han Xiao?!

Li Ge's sad story was spread by the other players, and they couldn't stop laughing. They were even more determined to follow Han Xiao. Han Xiao was indeed a guiding light. They didn't know much about the galaxy, so following Han Xiao would definitely bring them the most benefits. It was much more efficient than trying their luck everywhere.

…

With the efforts of the players, the Mercenary Group's Credibility Points accumulated bit by bit. (Latest update)

Han Xiao rented a Machinery Modification Room and gambled on blueprints a few times with new knowledge. He used the materials brought by Blue Star to create an independent combat helmet called the Sin-A Carbon-Based Biological Detector (Helmet). It contained multi-layered detection and could scan for life signals within a few kilometers. It also had a more powerful radar function, and it also had a certain level of protection, air filtration, and other life support systems. Han Technician made a few dozen of them and planned to sell them to the players. They were essential support equipment for missions.

After a few days, 'Meat' Bao finally edited the first episode of Interstellar Adventure, and it became a hot topic on the forums.

"Galaxy Adventure Log: Black Star Chapter (1)"!

The title of this episode had already indicated that this was a new series. The opening scene was changed to the cosmic scenery of Short Horn Star and Juberly Hub, as well as various strange interstellar species. A few minutes after it was released, there was already a large number of viewers. The Black Phantom series that 'Meat' Bao had done before had already accumulated a solid fan base.

His new series was highly anticipated when it was announced. It was the first show to enter the galaxy, and the audience was not only the Blue Star players, but also the foreign players from other novice planets. The number of viewers increased by a few times, and in just ten minutes, it almost equaled the highest number of viewers of the past episodes.

'Meat' Bao was extremely popular this time. His popularity increased again, and he became the number one player in the video channel.

"Wow, he still remembers to update!"

"What the f * ck, 320,000 viewers at the same time, am I seeing things?"

"Guys, I'm so excited!"

"My foreign friends, let me see your hands!"

'Meat' Bao's face appeared on the screen, and he started his usual opening with a despicable tone. "Welcome to Galaxy Adventure Log, I'm 'Meat' Bao. Don't you feel that something is missing? That's right, there's no opening poem for this episode! Because I haven't thought about it yet! "

The comments went wild. (Latest Update)

"Impossible to guard against!"

"This host is shameless. I'm following him."

"I'll beat this son of a bitch to death!"

For the first episode of the Black Star chapter, 'Meat' Bao used a special editing method. He did not focus on the introductions as usual. He edited the process of Han Xiao bringing the players to Juberly Hub on Short Horn Star into a movie-like feeling. The introduction was abandoned, and only some humorous narration was added. Coupled with some 'color' rendering, it was refreshing to the audience, as if they were watching a series.

Because there was too much material, 'Meat' Bao could not choose, so he simply made it into a story-type video. The length exceeded an hour. The success of the Black Phantom series made him even more ambitious, and he was no longer limited to the introduction and despicable style. Therefore, he made a new attempt with a more artistic style. The results were obvious, and it was a great success.

Han Xiao gave him ambition and opportunity.

As the video progressed, the scene of the galaxy was also displayed in front of the audience. The vast universe, countless stars, and spaceships of all shapes and sizes made the audience feel like they were in a black hole, mesmerizing them. When Han Xiao appeared, there was a second wave of comments.

"Xiao Chi is here!"

"Absorbing Black Phantom at close range!"

"Carrying Black Phantom is a 100-meter sprint!"

"Han Xiao is my husband, no rebuttal!"

"Wow, Black Phantom is in heaven, there will be no more chests to open in the future. I still want to gamble! I want to prove my bloodline! "

"Brother, go to sleep, you have everything in your dreams."

A large group of comments floated over, and many of them seemed to be 'fangirls', but it was not clear how many of them were hooligans …

'Meat' Bao also edited the interaction of the professional players into the video. Of course, this was agreed upon. This group of professional players were familiar with each other and teased each other daily. The interaction was very interesting, and the existence of this group of professional players attracted many fans to watch the video. Many fans of the players sent comments. Then, the scavenger attack appeared, and Han Xiao led the players to protect the spaceship. The comments were rolling, and there were all kinds of comments.

"Shocking, in this interstellar travel simulator, you can even level up by killing monsters."

"Black Phantom is still fierce, not only is he strong in Blue Star, but he can still defeat his enemies in the interstellar."

"Seeing that the Big Han Xiao is still so awesome, I am relieved."

On the way to Juberly Hub, the huge space station shocked the audience, and the video also came to an end. The last scene was when Han Xiao led the players to the Mercenary Alliance, and everyone registered as mercenaries. Han Xiao formed a mercenary group, and the players joined one after another. Then, the camera zoomed in and locked onto the words' Black Star Mercenary 'and froze for a full three seconds! The audience also watched for a full three seconds!

Then, the screen went black, and the annoying "To be continued" popped up.

'Meat' Bao chose to cut the video here because he saw that this group had a lot of potential. Other than the leader, the members were all players. Watching a familiar NPC lead a group of players and experience some kind of adventure in the interstellar would definitely arouse the audience's interest.

The reality was just as he expected. When the video ended, the audience felt that they had not had enough and did not feel the passage of time. They were all engrossed in the video and even felt like they were following the show.

The last three seconds of the video, coupled with the strong interest in the future of the mercenary group, made the name 'Black Star' deeply etched in the audience's mind.

Of course, another consequence was that the scale of the urging for this episode was unprecedentedly large …

"So cool, please update quickly!"

"Waiting for the second episode!"

"Ahhh, it's like locking Meat Bao in a small black room and slapping him to death if he can't make a video!"

"Erm … I think he might enjoy it."

"What are you thinking about above? Slapping is obviously a slap in the face. Your thoughts are not pure. I feel ashamed for you. If I were you, I would f * cking die on the spot!"

The number of viewers for this episode increased exponentially, causing a phenomenal sensation. The audience was wild, and there were also other professional players who were not chosen by Han Xiao who were envious and hated themselves for not being able to hold on for thirty seconds. The impact of 'Meat' Bao's episode even made the Galaxy Times, which was released immediately after, hurriedly add a section to share the video clip and give their own comments.

"Many episodes ago, we once deduced that the storyline characters had their own limitations. When the storyline on them was over, to the players, they would disappear into the crowd. But this time, we found that this deduction was wrong. Black Phantom Han Xiao … Oh, now he should be called Black Star Han Xiao, he proved our mistake. His range of activities was not limited by the civilization level of the planet itself. He went into the galaxy and started the Blue Star, and a new storyline was extended from him!"

"We once thought that Han Xiao was only the main character of Blue Star. But now, it seems that everyone guessed wrong. He has more than one war storyline, and he has a storyline that goes deeper into the galaxy. Compared to other novice planets, the development potential of Blue Star itself is very limited, but there is a pioneer like Han Xiao, and he has always been guiding the storyline forward."

"Black Star Han Xiao, he is not only the main character of a planet-level storyline!"

The Galaxy Times was brave enough to admit their wrong deduction, and their sincere attitude was well received by the audience. At the same time, it also contributed to the sensation caused by Han Xiao. The divine assistance made Han Xiao's impression in the hearts of the players rise from the so-called planet-level main character to a higher level, which made the players even more curious.

— — How far can he go?

Han Xiao also watched these two episodes, and the effect achieved what he wanted. His increasing status in the eyes of the players meant that he was accepted on a deeper level.

Countless players were excitedly discussing it on the forums, and the popularity continued to rise, becoming the hottest topic.

But no one would have thought that this episode of 'Meat' Bao's' video would not only be popular for a short period of time, but it would also last longer than anyone could imagine. In the future, countless people would come back to 'archaeology', and it would be known as —
